entities.summary: Nicholas Frederick Brady is an American banker and politician from New Jersey who briefly served in the United States Senate for eight months in 1982 and served as the 68th United States Secretary of the Treasury under U.S. Presidents Ronald Reagan and George H. W. Bush from 1988 to 1993. He is a member of the Republican Party. Nicholas F. Brady was a performers & entertainers from Manhattan (b. 1930-04-11, Manhattan). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
